title: V-JEPA Hand: Simple, Accurate and Fast 3D Hand and Camera Trajectory Recovery from Egocentric Videos
abstract: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.
tldr: V-JEPA Hand 用单次前向视频模型联合恢复第一视角视频中的双手与相机轨迹。
motivation: 现有方法通常将手部检测、手部重建、相机跟踪和轨迹优化拆分为多阶段流水线，流程复杂且容易产生误差累积；该研究希望从第一视角视频中联合恢复双手运动与相机自运动，并在统一世界坐标系中表达手部轨迹。
method: 该方法采用自监督 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器从全帧视频提取时空特征，并用基于 query 的预测器解码出逐帧手部姿态、手部存在性和相机运动；再利用预测的相机运动将手部轨迹变换到共同世界坐标系，支持已知焦距或在缺失时预测焦距，单次前向即可重建整个视频片段，并以伪标注视频和高精度 3D 标注进行单阶段端到端训练。
result: 单一模型在 ARCTIC、HOT3D 和 EgoStandard 上取得可比基线中最低的 coverage-aware MPJPE，并在世界坐标系轨迹误差上优于对比的 SLAM 流水线；消融实验验证了视频预训练、时序上下文和混合监督的有效性，在单张 RTX A6000 上前向吞吐达到 93.4 FPS。
conclusion: V-JEPA Hand 提供了一种简单、准确且快速的前馈式联合手部与相机轨迹恢复方案，避免了多阶段流水线的复杂性，在机器人学习、增强现实和人类活动理解等第一视角视频应用中具有潜在价值。

title: PlanarCityLoc: Breaking Silhouette Ambiguity in LoD Aerial Localization via 3D Planes
abstract: Aerial visual localization is crucial for autonomous drone navigation in urban environments where GNSS signals are often degraded. Lightweight textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a geometric map alternative to textured assets. Existing silhouette-based methods rely on image-space alignment, which can leave different camera poses indistinguishable and favor incorrect poses when segmentation errors distort the building outlines. We present PlanarCityLoc, which moves beyond silhouette overlap by leveraging the planar geometry of building facades and roofs. Following geometry-aware initialization, we match image-side planar patches to LoD model planes and use the resulting 3D-to-2D correspondences to refine pose with Perspective-n-Point (PnP). The framework uses off-the-shelf geometry and segmentation models without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2 achieve state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods. By grounding image-space alignment in 3D planes, PlanarCityLoc enables more accurate aerial localization with lightweight, textureless city maps.
tldr: PlanarCityLoc利用LoD建筑平面几何匹配与PnP优化，缓解轮廓歧义，实现轻量无纹理城市模型下的航拍定位。
motivation: 城市环境中无人机自主导航亟需航拍视觉定位，但GNSS信号常退化；轻量无纹理的LoD城市模型可作为纹理地图的几何替代。现有基于轮廓的方法依赖图像空间对齐，易使不同相机位姿难以区分，并在分割误差扭曲建筑轮廓时偏向错误位姿。
method: PlanarCityLoc不再依赖轮廓重叠，而是利用建筑立面与屋顶的平面几何：先进行几何感知初始化，再将图像侧平面块与LoD模型平面匹配，得到3D-to-2D对应关系后用PnP精化位姿。框架使用现成几何与分割模型，无需数据集特定训练或微调。
result: 在UAVD4L-LoDv2和Swiss-EPFLv2上，PlanarCityLoc在所评估的现成LoD-based方法中取得state-of-the-art定位召回率；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 通过将图像空间对齐建立在3D平面上，PlanarCityLoc突破了轮廓歧义，使轻量无纹理城市地图也能支持更准确的航拍定位。其贡献在于无需特定训练即可利用现成模型实现平面几何引导的LoD定位，对城市无人机导航具有潜在影响。

title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
abstract: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.
tldr: 提出EgoXperience全栈范式，用自动标注数据训练EgoX，实现第一视角视频中相机、场景、手与物体的联合度量重建。
motivation: 从第一视角视频重建人类活动不仅需要恢复单个3D组件，还需让观察者运动、周围几何与手物交互在同一世界坐标系中保持一致。现有方法与数据集对联合重建和对齐监督的支持均有限。
method: 构建自动标注引擎EgoX-Engine，将几何验证的目标跟踪与基于SLAM的世界对齐结合，生成相机、场景、手和物体的一致监督；据此构建50小时EgoX-Data-6M数据集与1小时EgoX-Bench基准，并训练统一模型EgoX。给定单目第一视角视频和首帧物体掩码，EgoX通过单次前向传播在共享世界坐标系中联合度量重建相机、场景、手与物体。
result: 实验表明EgoX在场景估计和世界空间手物姿态恢复上达到state-of-the-art；相较最强基线，相机、手和深度误差分别降低68.9%、65.6%和42.9%，物体姿态得分提升28.0%。
conclusion: EgoXperience打通数据采集、自动标注、统一建模与基准评测，为一致的世界 grounded 第一视角重建提供数据与方法基础，有望推动具身智能、AR/VR和人类行为理解等应用。

title: DenseHap: Dense Hand Haptic Estimation from Monocular Images
abstract: As dexterous robotic manipulation advances, scalable annotations of human hand-object interactions are becoming increasingly important. Furthermore, previous hand contact estimation methods suffered from issues such as dorsal-side misclassifications and insufficient precision, while lacking a unified framework for integrating multiple hand to environment interaction modalities, including distance fields, contact thresholds, and pressure. To address that, we present DenseHap, a unified end-to-end approach to estimate hand distance field recognition, comprehensive hand contact detection, hand pressure analysis, and hand reconstruction from a single monocular image. By incorporating three distinctly defined heads, along with a pretrained 3D reconstructed skeleton and an enhanced dataset, DenseHap outperforms previous state of the art models on four evaluation datasets, improving the F1 score by 8.5 percentage points (a 16% relative improvement) on untrained datasets and by 3 percentage points (5% relative improvement) on in-distribution datasets. Furthermore, DenseHap has effectively improved short-range hand estimate and pressure evaluation. Code and models will be publicly available upon the paper's acceptance.
tldr: DenseHap从单目图像统一估计手部距离场、接触、压力与手部重建，并在多个数据集上显著超越现有方法。
motivation: 机器人灵巧操作需要可扩展的人手-物体交互标注，但现有手部接触估计存在手背侧误分类、精度不足等问题，且缺乏统一框架整合距离场、接触阈值和压力等多种手-环境交互模态。
method: 提出DenseHap端到端统一方法，从单张单目图像同时估计手部距离场、全面接触检测、压力分析和手部重建；通过三个明确定义的任务头，结合预训练3D重建骨架与增强数据集实现多任务学习。
result: 在四个评估数据集上优于先前SOTA：未训练数据集F1提升8.5个百分点（相对提升16%），分布内数据集提升3个百分点（相对提升5%），并有效改善短距离手部估计与压力评估。
conclusion: DenseHap提供了统一密集手部触觉估计框架，提升了接触、压力与距离场估计精度，为机器人操作中可扩展的手-物交互标注提供支持；代码和模型将在论文接收后公开。

title: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation
abstract: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer
tldr: 提出免迭代可微的PnP-Transformer位姿求解器，以半稠密2D-3D对应与置信度回归6D位姿，并在BOP上实现低延迟但有精度权衡。
motivation: 经典PnP-RANSAC依赖迭代且不可微，难以嵌入端到端学习流程；本文旨在提供一种免迭代、可微的神经位姿求解器作为替代。
method: PnP-Transformer处理预测的半稠密2D-3D对应场及置信度分数，并将几何输入映射到连续隐空间以回归6D物体位姿；作者将其集成到零样本6D位姿估计流程中，对应模块与位姿求解器分开训练。
result: 在七个核心BOP数据集上取得41.2%平均AR、0.46秒/物体的低延迟，超过RayPose的39.1% AR但低于Co-op的58.4% AR；保持对应模块不变并改用EPnP-RANSAC时，在七个数据集中的六个上更优，达到52.2%平均AR，但每个物体增加60 ms开销。
conclusion: 结果表明PnP-Transformer是一种可行的低延迟、可微神经位姿求解方案，但与RANSAC替代方案相比存在明显精度-延迟权衡；该工作揭示了神经求解器与传统几何求解器在实际流程中的取舍。

title: Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention
abstract:
Sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for AR/VR and real-time communication applications, yet remains challenging when reconstructing 3D scenes from limited viewpoints. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excels in dense-view scenarios, it suffers from overfitting and geometry degradation under sparse inputs. Current approaches often tackle these problems from a local perspective, addressing either data quality or training regularization individually, lacking a unified and interpretable framework for systematic improvement.
  We introduce a new perspective that reframes sparse-view 3DGS from a few-shot learning viewpoint, treating each Gaussian primitive as a neuron and leveraging deep learning regularization techniques. Under this unified framework, our approach generates more effective supervision from scarce observations through two strategies: (1) data-related supervision enrichment via optical flow-guided pseudo-view synthesis and joint camera-scene optimization; and (2) training-time regularization via motion-aware dropout and early stopping, which suppress overfitting while preserving dynamic-scene stability. Extensive experiments on the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge sparse-view dataset demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art optimization-based and feed-forward baselines. Our system won first place in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 challenge.
tldr: 从少样本学习视角统一重构稀疏视角3DGS，通过伪视角监督与训练正则抑制过拟合。
motivation: 稀疏视角新视角合成对AR/VR与实时通信很重要，但3DGS在稀疏输入下易过拟合且几何退化。现有方法多分别处理数据质量或训练正则，缺乏统一且可解释的系统性改进框架。
method: 将每个高斯基元视为神经元，把稀疏视角3DGS重新表述为少样本学习问题，并引入深度学习正则化技术。具体包括光流引导的伪视角合成与相机-场景联合优化来丰富监督，以及运动感知dropout和早停进行训练期正则，在抑制过拟合的同时保持动态场景稳定性。
result: 在SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge稀疏视角数据集上，方法显著优于当前最优的优化型与前馈型基线，并获该挑战赛稀疏视角赛道第一名；摘要未提供具体量化数值指标。
conclusion: 工作提供了统一、可解释的少样本学习框架来系统改善稀疏视角3DGS，结合监督增强与训练正则取得竞赛级验证。该视角对稀疏视角体积视频重建及AR/VR、实时通信应用具有潜在影响。

title: OV-PEAR: Observation-Verified Pose-Scale Estimation and Reconstruction for Unknown Industrial Manipulation Objects
abstract: Fine industrial robotic manipulation requires 6D pose, scale, and an operation-ready 3D model. Existing industrial pose estimation relies on CAD models, object-specific training data, or stable workcells, limiting use with unseen objects; zero-shot methods suffer from single-view occlusion, generative bias, and scale uncertainty. We present OV-PEAR, an observation-verified framework for 3D reconstruction and pose-scale estimation of unknown industrial objects. Its three-stage object-centric pipeline: (1) segments RGB-D instances and generates object-level 3D hypotheses; (2) anchors them to the robot frame via appearance-aware view retrieval, explicit scale search, and visibility-sensitive registration; (3) back-projects multi-view RGB-D evidence into the object-canonical frame to verify voxel occupancy, suppress hallucinations, and produce reusable trusted object models. On BOP-Industrial, OV-PEAR achieves 0.657 average AR and improves pose and voxel-level geometric consistency in real scenes; real-robot connector assembly reaches 99.67% grasp and 84.00% assembly success. The model library and pose-scale log enable short-term object-level state maintenance at 0.02 ms/frame.
tldr: OV-PEAR通过多视角观测验证实现未知工业物体的6D位姿、尺度估计与可信三维重建。
motivation: 现有工业位姿估计依赖CAD模型、对象特定训练数据或稳定工作单元，难以处理未见物体；零样本方法则受单视角遮挡、生成偏差和尺度不确定性影响。研究旨在为未知工业操作物体同时获得6D位姿、尺度和可操作的三维模型。
method: OV-PEAR采用三阶段以物体为中心的流程：先分割RGB-D实例并生成物体级三维假设；再通过外观感知视角检索、显式尺度搜索和可见性敏感配准将假设锚定到机器人坐标系；最后将多视角RGB-D证据反投影到物体规范坐标系，验证体素占用、抑制幻觉并生成可复用的可信物体模型。
result: 在BOP-Industrial上平均AR达到0.657，并在真实场景中提升位姿与体素级几何一致性；真实机器人连接器装配取得99.67%抓取成功率和84.00%装配成功率，模型库与位姿-尺度日志支持0.02 ms/帧的短期物体级状态维护。
conclusion: OV-PEAR减少了对CAD模型和对象特定训练数据的依赖，可为未知工业物体提供经过观测验证的位姿、尺度与可复用三维模型。其模型库和位姿-尺度日志支持高效的物体级状态维护，对未知物体机器人操作具有应用潜力。

title: RxGS: Relightable Gaussian Stylization via BRDF Decomposition
abstract: Reference-based 3D scene stylization transfers the appearance of a reference image onto a reconstructed 3D scene while preserving scene geometry. Recent methods perform this transfer by optimizing the appearance representation of neural scene models including Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). These methods optimize an RGB appearance representation, in which a single per-point colour combines the effects of material reflectance, environment illumination, together with the shading it produces, and the viewing direction. When stylization modifies this combined colour, the illumination effects present during stylization are baked into the stored appearance, so the stylized scene cannot be rendered under different illumination. To address this limitation, we present RxGS, a relightable 3D scene stylization framework built on a Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF)-aware 3D Gaussian representation. Rather than modifying a per-point RGB colour, RxGS optimizes only the diffuse albedo field recovered by inverse rendering, while leaving roughness, metallicity, surface normals, and the estimated environment lighting unchanged. As a result, the stylized scene keeps all the components a physically-based renderer needs other than the edited albedo, and can therefore still be relit. RxGS optimizes the albedo field using a nearest-neighbour feature matching loss together with a spatial smoothness prior over Gaussian centres. We evaluate the method using a Geometry Consistency Cost (GCC) based on optical-flow warping error. RxGS achieves the lowest GCC on all evaluated NeRF-Synthetic scenes and remains competitive on real-captured scenes, while additionally supporting relightable stylization, which existing reference-based 3D scene stylization methods do not provide.
tldr: RxGS通过BRDF分解仅编辑漫反射反照率，实现可重光照的参考式3D高斯风格化。
motivation: 现有参考式3D场景风格化通常优化每点RGB外观，将材质反射、环境光照、着色和视角效应耦合在一起，导致风格化后的光照被烘焙进外观，无法在不同光照下重渲染。本文旨在解决该限制，使风格化场景仍可重光照。
method: 提出RxGS，基于BRDF感知的3D高斯表示，不修改每点RGB，而是仅优化逆渲染得到的漫反射反照率场，保持粗糙度、金属度、表面法线和估计环境光照不变。采用最近邻特征匹配损失及高斯中心空间平滑先验优化反照率场。
result: 使用基于光流扭曲误差的几何一致性代价GCC评估；在全部NeRF-Synthetic场景取得最低GCC，在真实拍摄场景保持竞争力，并额外支持现有方法不具备的可重光照风格化。
conclusion: RxGS将参考式3D风格化与BRDF分解结合，在保留物理渲染所需其他组件的同时实现可重光照的风格化。其贡献在于避免光照烘焙并扩展3D场景风格化的重光照能力，对可重光照神经/高斯场景编辑具有潜在影响。

title: Recurrent Vision Transformers for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation Under Slow Relative Motions
abstract: Vision-based object pose estimation is vital for conducting spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO). Recent research has demonstrated the robustness of event cameras against the harsh lighting conditions that often occur in orbit, thanks to the extremely high dynamic range of event sensors. However, event-based spacecraft pose estimation (EBSPE) suffers when the relative motion between the chaser and target is slow, since the event rate drops significantly, leading to data with low signal-to-noise ratio. Unfortunately, for safety reasons, real RPO trajectories often involve slow relative motions (e.g., down to 1 mm/s), and operating under low illumination exacerbates the problem. Addressing slow relative motions is thus crucial to raise the practicality of EBSPE. To this end, we propose using recurrent vision transformers (RVT) for EBSPE. The key idea is to exploit recurrent memory to capture longer-term information across sparse event streams, and to learn the temporal attention span from full trajectories rather than fixing the time window. We developed an RVT-based heatmap regressor to produce 2D-3D correspondences for pose estimation, which was validated on real event data collected under slow relative motions representative of RPO trajectories. Results indicate the superior pose estimation accuracy and stability of our RVT-based method, relative to previous per-event-frame-based or fixed-time-window EBSPE methods.
tldr: 提出递归视觉Transformer，利用递归记忆提升慢相对运动下事件相机航天器位姿估计精度与稳定性。
motivation: 事件相机适合轨道强光照环境，但在追逃航天器相对运动缓慢时事件率显著下降，导致低信噪比数据，严重影响事件-based航天器位姿估计（EBSPE）的实用性；真实RPO轨迹常包含低至1 mm/s的慢速运动，低照度会进一步加剧该问题。
method: 采用递归视觉Transformer（RVT）进行EBSPE，核心是利用递归记忆在稀疏事件流中捕获更长时序信息，并从完整轨迹中学习时间注意力跨度而非固定时间窗；构建基于RVT的热图回归器生成2D-3D对应关系以估计位姿。
result: 在代表RPO轨迹的慢相对运动真实事件数据上验证，所提RVT方法相较以往基于逐事件帧或固定时间窗的EBSPE方法具有更优的位姿估计精度与稳定性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作表明递归视觉Transformer可有效缓解慢相对运动下事件稀疏和低信噪比带来的EBSPE性能退化，提升事件相机航天器位姿估计在真实RPO场景中的实用性。

title: ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer
abstract: We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\times$ speedup, a $34\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}
tldr: ReDT通过固定大小基元令牌在紧凑空间计算多视图对应关系，实现高效可扩展的高清三维重建。
motivation: 现有视觉几何Transformer通常在固定标准分辨率下训练，面对高分辨率输入时重建质量下降且计算扩展性差。已有高效架构主要降低帧间注意力复杂度，但代价高昂的帧内注意力和编码器注意力仍未解决，使高清重建难以实用。
method: ReDT采用分辨率感知架构，先将每个视图映射为固定大小的基元令牌集合，在该紧凑恒定大小的基元空间中计算对应关系，再将输出投影回原始分辨率进行稠密预测。通过在注意力中解耦内部表示与输入分辨率，ReDT显著降低高分辨率三维重建计算成本，并提升各分辨率下的模型性能。
result: 在从标准分辨率到全高清（2K）的多个数据集上，ReDT在重建质量和计算效率上均优于最先进视觉几何Transformer。例如在ETH3D（2K）上，相比VGGT-Ω实现16倍加速、峰值GPU内存降低34%、Chamfer距离降低33%。
conclusion: ReDT通过分辨率解耦将前馈多视图重建有效扩展到高清输入，在质量与效率上同时取得提升。该设计为实用化高分辨率三维重建提供了可扩展的新路线。

title: LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization
abstract: Visual localization is critical for embodied agents, but deploying state-of-the-art deep feature matchers on edge devices is fundamentally limited by their massive computational cost. Standard deep matchers tightly interleave intra-image context building and inter-image matching at every layer, creating a severe interaction bottleneck. Localizing a single query against K database images forces the system to execute the full network K independent times with no capacity for caching. To break this bottleneck, we advocate for a paradigm shift toward cacheable image matching. We realize this paradigm with LateMatch, a versatile approach that restructures existing matchers by deferring inter-image interaction to their final layers. By isolating intra-image processing into offline-cacheable Context Blocks, only a small set of Interaction Blocks must be executed online. To further optimize LateMatch, we introduce E-SToRE (Entropy-guided Spatial Token Reduction and Expansion). E-SToRE leverages the decreasing Shannon entropy of the late Interaction Blocks to dynamically reduce token counts just prior to cross-image interaction. Evaluated across HPatches, ScanNet, MegaDepth, ETH-3D, and Aachen, LateMatch reduces effective computational cost by over 2x compared to standard deep matchers, while E-SToRE yields an additional 10% to 14% savings with negligible degradation in accuracy.
tldr: LateMatch通过将跨图交互后置并缓存单图上下文，实现高效视觉定位，计算开销降低2倍以上。
motivation: 现有深度特征匹配器在每层交织单图上下文构建与跨图匹配，针对K张数据库图像需重复执行完整网络K次且无法缓存，成为边缘设备视觉定位的严重交互瓶颈。
method: LateMatch将跨图交互推迟到网络末端，把单图处理隔离为可离线缓存的Context Blocks，仅在线执行少量Interaction Blocks；并引入E-SToRE，利用后期交互块香农熵下降动态进行空间token缩减与扩展。
result: 在HPatches、ScanNet、MegaDepth、ETH-3D和Aachen上，LateMatch将有效计算成本较标准深度匹配器降低2倍以上，E-SToRE额外节省10%至14%且精度退化可忽略。
conclusion: 该工作提出可缓存图像匹配范式，在不显著损失精度的情况下显著提升视觉定位效率，为边缘设备部署深度匹配器提供可行路径。

title: MCSplat: Multi-View Photometric and Geometric Consistent Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes
abstract: Driving-scene reconstruction via feed-forward Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images remains challenging due to two factors. First, cross-camera photometric inconsistency, caused by variations in exposure, ISP, and illumination, can be incorrectly absorbed into Gaussian geometry. Second, unreliable local geometric supervision arises from normal-based constraints near depth discontinuities. To address these issues, we present \textbf{MCSplat}, a multi-view consistent feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for driving scenes. MCSplat constructs a canonical appearance space from depth-guided multi-camera correspondences to decouple geometry learning from camera-specific appearance. A multi-scale Bilateral Grid Transformer restores raw camera appearance from canonical renderings, enabling photometric supervision without contaminating Gaussian geometry. To improve local geometric reliability, we estimate Fisher-information-based uncertainty from photometric sensitivity and use it to adaptively weight surface-oriented self-supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and generalization across driving datasets. Geometry-oriented evaluations further reveal enhanced cross-view depth consistency and local surface-normal agreement, while qualitative results show fewer geometric artifacts and more coherent structures across overlapping views.
tldr: 提出MCSplat，通过规范外观空间与不确定性加权几何自监督，实现驾驶场景多视角光度与几何一致的前馈高斯泼溅重建。
motivation: 稀疏多视角驾驶场景的前馈高斯泼溅重建面临两个问题：曝光、ISP和光照差异导致跨相机光度不一致，并可能被错误吸收进高斯几何；深度不连续处的法向约束会带来不可靠的局部几何监督。
method: MCSplat从深度引导的多相机对应关系构建规范外观空间，将几何学习与相机特定外观解耦；采用多尺度Bilateral Grid Transformer从规范渲染恢复原始相机外观，从而在不污染高斯几何的情况下提供光度监督；并基于光度敏感性估计Fisher信息不确定性，自适应加权表面朝向自监督。
result: 实验表明该方法在多个驾驶数据集上提升了重建质量和泛化能力；几何评估显示跨视角深度一致性和局部表面法向一致性增强，定性结果呈现更少几何伪影和更连贯的重叠视角结构；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: MCSplat通过多视角光度一致建模和不确定性加权几何自监督，提高了驾驶场景前馈高斯泼溅重建的几何可靠性与跨视角一致性，有望促进稀疏多相机驾驶场景的鲁棒重建与泛化。

title: Localization and Neural Splatting on the Edge: An FPGA Scene Memory for Robots
abstract: Resource-constrained robots and autonomous vehicles need scene memories that localize a camera and render nearby views without a desktop GPU. Scene-coordinate regression (SCR) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) fit because they avoid an SfM stage, but ACEsplat-style pipelines are GPU-centered, and moving them to an edge FPGA is hard because SCR is pose-sensitive and 3DGS rendering is irregular and capacity-sensitive. We present LENS, an edge scene-memory acceleration system on the AMD KR260 that brings an ACEsplat-style workload to a low-power FPGA/ARM platform. Rather than proposing a new scene model, LENS co-designs the two dominant kernels with the board data path: an INT16 SCR accelerator that preserves pose accuracy, and a bit-exact fixed-point ordered 3DGS renderer that rewrites alpha transmittance as a log-sum-exp recurrence and removes provably useless streamed Gaussians. All LENS latency, power, and quality results are board-measured. The SCR engine preserves DSAC* localization accuracy at 25.42 ms, the on-board renderer reaches 34.11 dB on Cambridge against ACEsplat's 33.20, novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K reaches 27.84 dB against 26.11, and all ten Wayspots scenes reach the ACEsplat rendering target. LENS wins performance per watt over a Jetson Orin NX on every deployment task, by 1.9x to 5.7x at about a quarter of the power, and is faster in absolute latency on localization and Wayspots rendering. On-device training reaches ACEsplat-level quality but not the GPU's time or energy, marking the remaining boundary for a future training accelerator.
tldr: LENS在AMD KR260 FPGA/ARM平台上协同设计SCR定位与定点3DGS渲染，实现低功耗边缘场景记忆。
motivation: 资源受限机器人与自动驾驶车辆需要无需桌面GPU即可定位相机并渲染邻近视角的场景记忆。ACEsplat式流程以GPU为中心，而SCR对位姿敏感、3DGS渲染不规则且对容量敏感，难以直接迁移到边缘FPGA。
method: LENS并非提出新场景模型，而是在AMD KR260上协同设计两个主导内核与板级数据通路：保留位姿精度的INT16 SCR加速器，以及将alpha透射率重写为log-sum-exp递推并剔除可证明无用流式高斯的位级精确定点有序3DGS渲染器。所有延迟、功耗与质量结果均为板端实测。
result: SCR引擎在25.42 ms下保持DSAC*定位精度；板端渲染器在Cambridge上达34.11 dB（ACEsplat为33.20），在RealEstate10K新视角合成达27.84 dB（对比26.11），十个Wayspots场景均达到ACEsplat渲染目标。LENS在每项部署任务上的能效均优于Jetson Orin NX，约四分之一功耗下实现1.9x至5.7x提升，并在定位与Wayspots渲染的绝对延迟上更快。
conclusion: LENS证明ACEsplat式场景记忆工作负载可在低功耗FPGA/ARM边缘平台高效运行，并在能效与部分绝对延迟上优于Jetson Orin NX。板端训练可达ACEsplat级质量，但时间和能耗仍不及GPU，指出未来训练加速器的边界。

title: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.
tldr: FineSplat 通过细粒度图像块与双分组局部交互实现高效前馈 3DGS，显著提升细节重建。
motivation: 前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 可实现即时场景重建与新视角合成，但细粒度几何与外观仍难以恢复；高分辨率 token 下全局多视角注意力计算代价过高，需要重新设计细节信息的表示、聚合与精炼方式。
method: FineSplat 以细粒度图像块为核心构建前馈 3DGS，并提出双分组策略：视图分组促进邻近视图间高效交互，3D 空间分组将几何相关 token 提升到场景空间重新连接；同时利用重建误差作为基于渲染的显式反馈来恢复细节结构，并通过紧凑高斯生成方案在保留细粒度特征的同时避免基元数量膨胀。
result: 在相同或更小的高斯基元预算下，FineSplat 显著优于现有方法并取得 state-of-the-art 结果，能够恢复更丰富的几何与外观；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: FineSplat 通过细粒度图像块、双分组局部交互、渲染误差反馈与紧凑高斯生成，在保持高效与紧凑的同时提升细节重建质量，为前馈 3DGS 的细粒度场景重建提供了有效路线。

title: SwitchSplat: Learning Discrete Object States from Casually Captured Scenes
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has made high-fidelity 3D reconstruction fast and accessible, yet existing representations assume a static world. This assumption breaks down in casual captures, where a user naturally interacts with the environment -- opening doors, toggling switches, or moving objects -- introducing discrete state changes that no current framework can model. Time-conditioned dynamic methods such as 4DGS conflate when a state was observed with what state the scene is in, limiting them to replaying seen sequences rather than composing arbitrary object configurations. We present SwitchSplat, the first 3DGS representation to address this gap via a base+slot decomposition: a shared static base captures the invariant scene, while each slot independently holds the two binary states (on/off) of one interactable object. Because the assignment of Gaussians to slots is fully differentiable, the model discovers the geometry of each state directly from video, without manual annotation. At inference, the user can freely combine slot states and render the resulting scene from any viewpoint. We validate SwitchSplat on a new casual-capture dataset and show that it outperforms static and dynamic baselines in novel-view synthesis quality, while uniquely supporting rendering of state combinations never seen during capture. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io
tldr: SwitchSplat 通过可微 base+slot 分解从随手拍摄视频学习物体离散状态，并支持任意状态组合渲染。
motivation: 现有 3D Gaussian Splatting 假设场景静态，但随手拍摄中开门、拨动开关或移动物体会引入离散状态变化，当前框架无法建模。4DGS 等时间条件动态方法把状态被观测的时间与场景状态混为一谈，只能回放已见序列，无法组合任意物体配置。
method: SwitchSplat 采用 base+slot 分解：共享静态 base 表示不变场景，每个 slot 独立承载一个可交互物体的两种二值状态（on/off）。Gaussian 到 slot 的分配完全可微，因此模型可直接从视频中发现各状态几何而无需人工标注；推理时用户可自由组合 slot 状态并从任意视角渲染。
result: 在新建的随手拍摄数据集上，SwitchSplat 在新视角合成质量上优于静态与动态基线，并能渲染采集时从未见过的状态组合；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 这是首个用 3DGS 表示解决随手拍摄中离散物体状态建模缺口的工作，实现了可组合的状态编辑与任意视角渲染。其贡献在于将静态 base 与可交互物体状态解耦，为从日常视频构建可编辑 3D 场景提供了新路线。

title: Directionally Factorized Illumination with Spherical Harmonic Rotation
abstract: Many real-world capture scenarios involve an active light source rigidly attached to the camera: camera flashes for dark-environment imaging, underwater vehicle lights, and endoscopic/laparoscopic medical procedures. As the camera moves, the co-mounted light moves with it, causing the illumination direction at each surface point to change across views. Neural rendering methods (NeRF, Gaussian Splatting) encode this pose-dependent illumination as surface coloration, producing appearance inconsistencies and making it harder to recover the underlying scene. We present \textbf{DaFISH}, which can be plugged into any novel-view synthesis (NVS) pipeline such as NeRF. It factorizes per-point emitted color into surface albedo and a spherical harmonic (SH)-represented illumination factor. During training, the SH illumination is evaluated directly, enabling stable joint optimization of albedo, lighting, and geometry. \textbf{DaFISH} provides analytical generalization of illumination to arbitrary camera poses without retraining. Building on the closed-form SH-to-irradiance conversion, the training pipeline is fully differentiable from SH evaluation through volume rendering. Averaged over the held-out frames of the five scenes, \textbf{DaFISH} attains the best mean PSNR (38.91\,dB), SSIM (0.9613), and LPIPS (0.0582) among all compared methods. It improves over the strongest splatting baseline as well as the closest NeRF-based baseline, while recovering the scene consistently across views compared to prior methods.
tldr: DaFISH将逐点颜色分解为反照率与SH光照，支持相机共置光源下的新视角合成。
motivation: 许多真实采集场景中光源刚性固定在相机上，随视角变化导致表面点照明方向改变；现有NeRF和Gaussian Splatting将这种位姿相关光照编码为表面颜色，造成外观不一致并增加场景恢复难度。
method: DaFISH可插入任意新视角合成管线（如NeRF），将逐点发射颜色分解为表面反照率与球谐（SH）表示的光照因子。训练时直接评估SH光照，实现反照率、光照与几何的稳定联合优化，并基于闭式SH到辐照度转换使SH评估到体渲染全流程可微，从而无需重训练即可解析泛化到任意相机位姿。
result: 在五个场景的留出帧上，DaFISH取得最佳平均PSNR 38.91 dB、SSIM 0.9613和LPIPS 0.0582。其性能优于最强splatting基线和最接近的NeRF基线，并相较已有方法在跨视角下更一致地恢复场景。
conclusion: DaFISH通过方向因子化光照建模解决了相机共置主动光源下的位姿相关照明问题，可作为插件提升现有新视角合成管线的外观一致性与场景恢复质量。其闭式SH光照泛化能力对闪光摄影、水下和內窥镜等实际采集场景具有潜在影响。

title: O-SCD++: Replay-Free Online Scene Change Detection via Recursive Evidence Fusion
abstract: Online scene change detection requires an agent to detect what has changed in a previously mapped environment while it is still on site, observing from unconstrained viewpoints and without access to future observations. This causal setting is strictly harder than its offline counterpart, and online methods have consistently trailed offline accuracy. O-SCD closed that gap by treating change as a persistent property of a 3D Gaussian splatting map of the reference scene, surpassing the strongest offline methods in change detection accuracy while operating at over 10 frames per second. O-SCD optimizes a change field over the Gaussians of the reference map, refitting it to all past cue maps at every frame, a step that consumes more than half of the per-frame budget and forces accuracy to be traded against speed. We present a replay-free formulation that eliminates this trade-off. Because the reference map stays fixed, rendering the change field is a linear operation. Each new observation can therefore be carried onto the map's Gaussians directly, by a single backward pass of the renderer, which reduces multi-view fusion to an exact two-scalar recursion per Gaussian. Past observations are never stored or revisited. The self-supervised objective that O-SCD minimizes by descent also determines the decision threshold exactly, by sorting, yielding a label-free per-frame cutoff whose margin provides a selective-prediction signal. On PASLCD, our method improves mean intersection over union from 0.489 to 0.575 and throughput from 11.8 to 25.6 frames per second, even exceeding O-SCD's offline result while remaining strictly causal.
tldr: 提出无回放在线场景变化检测，将多视角融合转为高斯上的二标量递归，在PASLCD上兼顾精度与速度。
motivation: 在线场景变化检测需在已建图环境中从无约束视角实时判断变化，且不能使用未来观测，因果设置比离线更难，现有在线方法精度长期落后离线方法。O-SCD虽以3DGS变化场超过离线精度，但每帧重拟合所有历史线索图消耗过半预算，导致精度与速度难以兼顾。
method: O-SCD++利用参考地图固定时渲染变化场为线性操作，将每个新观测通过渲染器单次反向传播直接写到高斯的变化场上，从而把多视角融合化为每个高斯精确的二标量递归，无需存储或回放历史观测。其自监督目标还可通过排序精确确定无标签逐帧阈值，并利用阈值间隔提供选择性预测信号。
result: 在PASLCD上，mIoU从O-SCD的0.489提升至0.575，吞吐从11.8 FPS提升至25.6 FPS。该方法在严格因果的在线设置下甚至超过O-SCD的离线结果。
conclusion: O-SCD++以无回放递归证据融合消除了在线变化检测中精度与速度的权衡，实现更高精度和实时吞吐，并带来无标签阈值与选择性预测能力。其结果为因果在线3D场景变化检测提供了更实用且可扩展的范式。

title: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
abstract: We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation, or function. To find matching intervals, it composes operators into programs that check query conditions on driving joint trajectories stored in a motion memory. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.
tldr: 提出免训练框架HumanSkill-4D，用语言查询可动高斯化身在空间与时间中的局部区域和动作区间。
motivation: 现有语言高斯泼溅方法难以分离相邻身体部件与衣物，且间接指代会带来区域歧义；细粒度动作在RGB外观上高度相似，造成动作歧义。该工作旨在支持用户通过语言对可动化身进行局部编辑与动作检查，因此提出化身指代分割任务。
method: HumanSkill-4D无需训练，跨化身共享多模态大语言模型与几何算子。它为每个化身构建语义记忆，将身体部件和服装类别链接到持久高斯区域及外观描述，由MLLM按外观、关系或功能选择类别；同时构建存储驱动关节轨迹的运动记忆，让MLLM将算子组合为程序以检查查询条件，从而使选择可追踪并支持新增运动条件。
result: 作者构建了三个人工标注基准，并显示HumanSkill-4D在部件分割以及3D和4D指代分割任务上均优于基线方法；每个化身仅需数分钟设置，且记忆紧凑（摘要未提供具体量化数值）。
conclusion: 该工作提出化身指代分割新任务，使用户能够语言查询可动高斯化身的空间区域与时间动作区间，服务于局部编辑和动作检查。其免训练、跨化身共享和可追踪选择的设计降低了每化身部署成本，并推动了语言驱动的化身交互研究。

title: LonGaussian: Tracking Foundation Priors for Long-Context Feedforward Gaussian Reconstruction
abstract: Reconstructing high-quality, renderable 3D scenes from long videos is essential for robotic perception and embodied intelligence. Many feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction methods rapidly predict 3D scenes from a small set of images, but extending them to longer sequences presents two bottlenecks: jointly processing all views increases GPU memory requirements, while accumulating pixel-aligned predictions redundantly represents the same surfaces and increases storage and rendering costs. We present LonGaussian, a streaming feed-forward framework that reconstructs compact, globally renderable Gaussian scenes from long image sequences with known intrinsics and unknown camera poses. Built on a pretrained streaming 3D reconstruction backbone, LonGaussian decodes long-context geometric features into dense Gaussians. Within each chunk, multi-frame point tracks link repeated observations of the same surface and guide a learned merger to consolidate the corresponding Gaussian predictions. Rendered-depth consistency filtering further suppresses Gaussians from other chunks that incorrectly occlude locally reconstructed surfaces. On DL3DV and RealEstate10K benchmarks, LonGaussian improves novel-view rendering quality while using substantially fewer Gaussians than the evaluated feed-forward baselines.
tldr: LonGaussian以流式前馈方式从长视频重建紧凑且可全局渲染的高斯场景。
motivation: 现有前馈高斯重建方法多针对少量图像，扩展到长序列时面临两大瓶颈：联合处理所有视角导致显存开销激增，而逐像素对齐的预测累积会冗余表示同一表面，增加存储与渲染成本。目标是仅凭已知内参、未知位姿的长图像序列，流式重建紧凑可渲染的全局高斯场景。
method: 方法基于预训练的流式三维重建主干，将长上下文几何特征解码为稠密高斯；在每个分块内利用多帧点轨迹关联同一表面的重复观测，并引导学习式合并器整合对应高斯预测；再用渲染深度一致性过滤抑制其他分块中错误遮挡本地重建表面的高斯。
result: 在DL3DV与RealEstate10K基准上，LonGaussian提升了新视角渲染质量，同时所用高斯数量显著少于所对比的前馈基线。
conclusion: 该工作表明，结合点轨迹关联、学习式高斯合并与深度一致性过滤，可在流式前馈框架下实现长视频的紧凑全局高斯重建，为机器人感知与具身智能中的长时序三维建模提供了高效方案。

title: X-Splat: Unified Gaussian Splatting for Joint RGB and X-ray 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Jointly reconstructing RGB and X-ray provides new insights by connecting external appearance with internal structure, enabling a more complete understanding of real-world objects than single modality. Yet existing methods train separate models per modality and suffer from redundant geometry, alignment artifacts, and loose coupling that limits cross-modal insight discovery. We propose a unified representation in which all Gaussian primitives share a single set of geometric parameters, with only surface-proximal primitives additionally carrying appearance attributes. We perform cross-modal registration through clean multi-view stereo and X-ray geometric proxies instead of aligning two sets of optimized Gaussians, improving alignment stability. We then jointly optimize the unified representation via supervision from both modalities, complemented by a surface-depth consistency loss derived from X-ray geometry to guide RGB reconstruction. Experiments on the InsideOut dataset and our Flower & Insect dataset show that our framework achieves more robust cross-modal alignment, higher RGB rendering quality without compromising X-ray reconstruction, and a more compact representation than maintaining two independent geometries.
tldr: 提出统一高斯表示联合重建RGB与X射线，共享几何并提升跨模态对齐。
motivation: 现有RGB与X射线联合重建方法通常为每个模态单独训练模型，导致几何冗余、对齐伪影和跨模态耦合松散，限制了对外观与内部结构的整体理解。
method: 提出统一高斯表示，所有高斯基元共享同一套几何参数，仅靠近表面的基元额外携带外观属性；通过干净的多视图立体与X射线几何代理完成跨模态配准，而非对齐两组已优化高斯，并利用双模态监督联合优化，加入由X射线几何导出的表面深度一致性损失来引导RGB重建。
result: 在InsideOut数据集和自建Flower & Insect数据集上，该框架实现了更稳健的跨模态对齐和更高的RGB渲染质量，同时不损害X射线重建，并获得比维护两套独立几何更紧凑的表示；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作通过共享几何的统一高斯表示与代理配准策略，将RGB外观与X射线内部结构紧密耦合，在保持重建质量的同时提升对齐稳定性和表示紧凑性，为跨模态联合三维重建提供了新思路。

title: Frame-Consistent Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Unposed Images
abstract: Feed-forward Gaussian models have made novel view synthesis almost instantaneous. Feed-forward methods predict Gaussians directly, either in two stages or in a single merged pass. Using two separately trained models is attractive because each can specialize in its own objective: one for accurate pose estimation and the other for high-quality reconstruction, rather than forcing a single jointly trained network to compromise between the two. A natural instantiation pairs a frozen pose estimator, VGGT, with a frozen reconstruction backbone, TokenGS. Prior work, such as VGGT-X and 3R-GS, also adopts a two-stage design, but attributes the resulting quality degradation to noisy pose estimates and introduces learned refinement. We show that this is not the primary source of the problem. Through per-camera analysis across 107 scenes from two datasets, DL3DV and MipNeRF360, using COLMAP poses as the reference, we find that the rotation error after alignment is small (median 1.6 degrees), whereas the translation scale is offset by a large, dataset-consistent factor. Controlled ablations over 140 DL3DV scenes show that the primary obstacles are two integration failures rather than pose error: a coordinate-frame inconsistency and a translation-scale mismatch, both of which can be corrected deterministically. With these fixes, a frozen VGGT driving a frozen TokenGS achieves 22.47 PSNR, within 0.51 dB of the COLMAP reference, with no additional training, when poses are estimated from all scene views. In the sparse setting, where reconstruction uses only four context images under the standard pose-free protocol, the same pipeline matches this all-view quality, yielding a fully COLMAP-free pipeline without any refinement step.
tldr: 冻结VGGT与TokenGS的两阶段前馈高斯泼溅，经确定性坐标系与平移尺度修正后无需COLMAP即可高质量重建。
motivation: 两阶段前馈高斯方法可让位姿估计与重建模型各自专精，但现有VGGT-X、3R-GS等将质量退化主要归因于位姿噪声并引入学习式细化。本文重新审视该问题，旨在定位冻结位姿估计器与冻结重建骨干集成时的真正瓶颈。
method: 在DL3DV与MipNeRF360共107个场景上以COLMAP位姿为参考进行逐相机分析，并在140个DL3DV场景做受控消融；发现主要问题是以坐标系不一致和平移尺度失配为代表的集成失败，而非旋转误差，并采用确定性方法修正二者，直接连接冻结VGGT与冻结TokenGS。
result: 对齐后旋转误差中位数仅1.6度，但平移尺度存在数据集一致的显著偏移；修正后冻结VGGT驱动冻结TokenGS在全体视角位姿下达到22.47 PSNR，距COLMAP参考仅0.51 dB，无需额外训练。稀疏设置仅用4张上下文图像时，同一流程仍匹配全视角质量，且无需细化步骤。
conclusion: 研究表明两阶段前馈高斯退化的主因是可确定性修正的坐标系与尺度集成问题，而非位姿噪声；该修复实现了完全无需COLMAP、无需学习式细化的稀疏无位姿重建流程，对前馈高斯重建系统有直接价值。

title: Semantic-Critical Regions for Video-to-Audio Generation
abstract: In real-world videos, sound events are often associated with localized and fine-grained visual cues, such as object motion, object-part dynamics, contact events, and interactions between objects. Existing video-to-audio (V2A) methods employ implicit conditioning based on global visual representations or explicit control derived from temporal and spatial cues. However, subtle sound-producing and sound-indicative interactions remain insufficiently captured, leaving room for more precise visual conditioning of sound-event semantics and temporal dynamics. Motivated by this observation, we refer to regions containing such sound-relevant visual evidence as Semantic-Critical Regions (SCRs) and introduce SCR-V2A, a V2A generation framework that explicitly localizes and encodes SCRs as fine-grained visual guidance for audio generation. Specifically, we first identify SCRs through sound-related visual localization. We then transform the localized regions into a control representation through adapter-based dual visual encoding, which jointly captures global visual context and fine-grained sound-relevant evidence. The representation is used to condition a downstream audio generation model. Experiments on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks demonstrate that SCR-V2A achieves strong performance in distribution matching and audio quality while remaining competitive in cross-modal alignment and requiring few trainable parameters. These results highlight the value of prioritizing fine-grained, sound-relevant visual regions for V2A generation.
tldr: 提出SCR-V2A，通过定位并编码语义关键区域为视频到音频生成提供细粒度视觉引导。
motivation: 现有视频到音频方法多依赖全局视觉表示或时序与空间显式控制，难以充分捕捉细微的发声与指示声音的局部视觉交互，因此需要更精确地条件化声音事件语义与时序动态。
method: SCR-V2A首先通过声音相关视觉定位识别语义关键区域SCR，再利用基于adapter的双路视觉编码将局部区域转化为控制表示，联合捕捉全局视觉上下文与细粒度声音相关证据，并以此条件化下游音频生成模型。
result: 在域内与域外基准上，SCR-V2A在分布匹配和音频质量方面表现较强，在跨模态对齐上具有竞争力，同时仅需少量可训练参数；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，优先利用细粒度且与声音相关的视觉区域对视频到音频生成具有价值，SCR-V2A的主要贡献在于显式定位并编码语义关键区域，为高精度且参数高效的音频生成提供了新思路。

title: Direct Conditional Parameterization for N-Dimensional Splatting
abstract: N-dimensional splatting extends 3D Gaussian Splatting with view direction and time to model view-dependent and dynamic effects. Each primitive is lifted into a joint distribution over position and conditioning variables, then conditionally sliced at each rendering query. N-DGS and UBS share this step across Gaussian and Beta kernels: recovering the conditional mean, opacity, and covariance requires per-primitive matrix inversions and regression products in every forward pass. We introduce direct conditional parameterization, replacing this covariance-derived readout with explicit per-effect parameters: a Cholesky precision factor for opacity and a factorized query-to-position regression operator with learnable per-dimension coupling. Unrestricted conditional coordinates recover a valid joint covariance; our factorization adds spatial-scale and coupling priors. Applied to both kernels, the parameterization yields dGS (Gaussian) and dBS (Beta). Across five static and dynamic benchmarks, they match or exceed their covariance-derived counterparts on quality, with gains up to +1.26 dB in the main MCMC evaluation. Production slicing is 6.9-7.7 times faster than on-the-fly covariance-derived conditioning; complete-render profiling gives 1.25-1.91 times speedups on four trained scenes. Direct conditioning provides a structured, kernel-agnostic alternative for N-dimensional splatting. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/dgs/.
tldr: 提出直接条件参数化，加速N维splatting并保持或提升渲染质量。
motivation: N维splatting将3D Gaussian Splatting扩展到视角方向与时间，以建模视角相关和动态效果，但每次渲染查询都需对每个primitive做矩阵求逆与回归乘积，计算开销大。
method: 提出直接条件参数化，用显式逐效果参数替代由协方差导出的条件读取：用Cholesky精度因子表示不透明度，并用带可学习逐维耦合的因子化查询到位置回归算子建模条件坐标；该方法应用于Gaussian和Beta核，分别得到dGS与dBS。
result: 在五个静态与动态基准上，dGS和dBS的质量匹配或超过协方差导出方法，主MCMC评估最高提升+1.26 dB；生产切片比动态协方差条件化快6.9-7.7倍，四个已训练场景的完整渲染剖析加速1.25-1.91倍。
conclusion: 该工作为N维splatting提供了一种结构化、与核无关的直接条件建模范式，在保持或提升质量的同时显著提升条件切片与完整渲染效率。

title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
abstract: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.
tldr: Gen4P将预训练视频生成器改造为前馈4D感知器，从单目视频统一恢复4D几何与运动。
motivation: 研究动机是从单目视频中统一恢复4D几何与运动，并探索预训练视频生成器作为4D感知器的潜力，避免传统迭代去噪带来的高开销。
method: 基于按需查询，Gen4P对干净视频隐变量进行单次编码，并用轻量跨注意力解码器预测所需4D属性；连续时间查询提供时间灵活性，同时将预训练video-depth LoRA作为冻结几何先验即插即用，增强几何知识且不增加可训练参数。
result: 在3D点跟踪、视频深度和相机位姿估计任务上取得SOTA或具有竞争力的性能；在野外视频上可跟踪复杂运动并保持精细结构，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明视频生成预训练可用于统一4D感知，为从单目视频进行前馈4D几何与运动恢复提供了新思路，并展现跨任务泛化潜力。

title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.
tldr: DK-VLM 将几何位置作为注意力调制，结合双核注意力与参考系组合监督，提升视觉语言模型的空间推理能力。
motivation: 视觉语言模型仍难以理解跨视角的 3D 空间关系，并在观察者移动时更新空间判断。常见做法是将 3D 重建特征融合进视觉 token，但在有限空间监督下，这些特征与预训练语义表示的对齐仍很困难。
method: 提出 DK-VLM 与 Dual-Kernel Attention：语义核保留预训练模型的原始注意力与位置编码，几何核利用估计的 3D 点和相机位姿，通过点位移与相对视角变换直接调制注意力，再由学习门融合二者，使几何以位置形式进入注意力而非作为融合的重建特征。进一步引入 Reference-Frame Composition 监督，基于已验证的单步标注生成逐步转向与朝向目标，训练模型在连续判断中更新参考系。
result: DK-VLM-8B 在六个空间基准上取得最高平均分，并在 VSI-Bench 与 ReVSI-32 上分别达到最高总分 74.33 和 58.28。RC 监督进一步提升了多步空间推理能力，同时完整模型保持了通用视频理解性能。
conclusion: DK-VLM 通过将几何作为位置调制注意力，并利用 RC 监督更新参考系，有效增强了视觉语言模型的空间推理与多步空间判断能力。该工作为 VLM 的 3D 空间理解提供了新思路，并在保持通用视频理解的同时取得空间基准领先结果。

title: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
abstract:
Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only.
  We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for π3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.
tldr: 提出运动与重力感知的前馈3D重建框架，用LUPI在训练时注入光流和重力先验，推理不增加复杂度并提升动态场景鲁棒性。
motivation: 前馈Transformer多视图3D重建性能强，但主要依赖外观注意力，在动态场景和几何线索薄弱时表现不佳。该工作旨在不增加推理代价的前提下，为前馈重建注入运动与物理先验。
method: 在LUPI范式下，训练时将残差光流和重力方向作为特权信息，通过轻量架构修改注入Transformer主干以引导几何表征学习；推理时仅使用标准视觉输入，保持前馈效率。并分析不同主干的先验注入阶段。
result: 在标准基准上，重建精度和鲁棒性获得一致提升，尤其在动态物体、结构歧义和困难相机运动场景。消融显示最佳注入阶段依赖主干：VGGT通常中间层更优，π3则后期融合更有效。
conclusion: 表明LUPI可将运动与物理先验有效注入前馈3D重建，提升动态场景性能且不增加测试时复杂度。贡献在于提出运动/重力感知框架并揭示注入阶段的主干依赖性，为后续多视图重建提供实用思路。

title: Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control
abstract: We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/
tldr: Edit4D提出分阶段文本到4D场景生成框架，通过分离背景与动态角色表示实现可编辑4D场景与可控相机运动。
motivation: 现有文本驱动动态场景生成方法通常生成整体场景视频，背景与动态角色耦合，难以进行对象级编辑和灵活相机控制。Edit4D旨在解决可编辑4D场景生成中保持空间几何与时间动态的难题。
method: Edit4D采用分阶段生成流程：先将用户指令分解为背景、动态角色及场景-角色组合的提示；利用文本到图像和相机条件生成先验合成多视角场景图像并重建背景3D高斯溅射表示；生成角色图像并用图像条件视频先验驱动动画，重建4D网格并绑定高斯基元；通过文本引导分割和接触感知优化组合两部分，最后进行全局场景细化以提升协调性与渲染一致性。
result: 摘要未提供相关信息
conclusion: Edit4D通过分阶段组件集成，实现了可控相机运动、灵活的对象级编辑以及可编辑4D场景的实用构建，为文本驱动的动态场景编辑提供了新方案。

title: Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation
abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.
tldr: 提出Anchor3DGS，无位姿前馈3DGS，用紧凑锚点表示减少高斯数量并提升新视角合成质量。
motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法多采用逐像素对齐范式，每个输入像素预测一个高斯，使高斯数量与输入分辨率和视角数耦合，并在纹理缺失区域产生冗余、在几何复杂区域覆盖不足。本文旨在以更紧凑的表示替代逐像素预测，解决冗余与覆盖不均问题。
method: Anchor3DGS是一个无位姿前馈3DGS框架，利用信息熵引导在场景中放置3D锚点，使其集中于高视觉复杂度区域并保持空间覆盖。每个锚点进行遮挡感知的多视角特征聚合、锚点间信息交换，并解码为一组局部高斯；轻量特征增强模块进一步细化高斯泼溅的粗略RGB输出。
result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Anchor3DGS在新视角合成质量上达到最先进水平，同时仅使用少一个数量级的高斯图元。
conclusion: 该工作证明紧凑锚点表示可有效替代像素对齐范式，显著减少高斯冗余并改善复杂区域覆盖与渲染保真度，为高效前馈3DGS重建提供了新方向。

title: Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map
abstract: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/
tldr: 提出免训练目标感知细化3D高斯语言地图，通过闭式系数融合文本嵌入提升目标定位与开放词汇分割，并支持机器人导航。
motivation: 现有将视觉语言特征蒸馏到3D Gaussian Splatting得到的语言地图，虽支持任意文本查询，但在部署中常无法可靠定位少量用户指定目标，同时还需保持对其他词的开放词汇查询能力。
method: 提出免训练的目标感知细化：用文本提示分割器定位目标区域，将区域内视觉嵌入与目标文本嵌入做凸组合，非目标区域不变；对每个目标闭式求解仍能胜出的最小注入系数，无需超参。还发现文本嵌入的共同分量会使标准余弦读出与查询无关，并通过读出端中心化消除该失败模式。
result: 在三个基准上持续提升开放词汇分割，Replica 上 mIoU 约翻倍，语言目标定位比基础地图更可靠；可作为插件迁移到 field-based 和对象级语言地图，并支持四足机器人导航到自然语言目标的真实演示。
conclusion: 该方法无需训练与调参即可提升目标定位和通用查询能力，增强了3D高斯语言地图的部署实用性，并为机器人语言目标导航提供可扩展方案。

title: AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
abstract: Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators specify task constraints that are unobservable via vision and report offline environmental modifications, whereas the robot provides physical-state evidence through active in-situ validation. Task relevance governs whether human-reported environmental changes undergo robot validation during the active mission. Field-collected perceptual evidence gates memory updates, maintaining an explicit separation between human-specified permissions and robot-observed traversability. Our experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that AVALON with X-NavDP completes a 12.81 m Intersection-to-Dining mission in 46.4 s (5/5) with no mapping, 40.9% less robot time than DimOS-Go2 (78.5 s, 4/5), while policy-only X-NavDP times out in all of the 5 runs. These demonstrate the superiority of the proposed topological navigation framework.
tldr: AVALON利用人类播种的分层拓扑记忆与证据门控协同更新，实现无需建图的零样本室内导航。
motivation: 室内服务机器人常需进入未建图但用户已熟悉的建筑，且面临视觉不可观测的任务约束与离线环境变更。论文旨在解决机器人无现场遍历、无站点特定训练情况下，如何利用人类先验知识实现可靠室内导航的问题。
method: AVALON是一个拓扑导航框架，包含人类播种的分层空间记忆、节点验证的拓扑执行，以及任务触发、证据门控的人机记忆协同更新。部署仅需平面图、地点线索和初始拓扑-里程计对齐；视觉深度点目标导航借助已验证节点到达进行平移重锚定，无需机器人构建全局SLAM地图。人操作员指定视觉不可观测的任务约束并报告离线环境变更，机器人通过主动原位验证提供物理状态证据，任务相关性决定人类报告的环境变化是否需机器人验证，感知证据门控记忆更新并显式区分人类指定权限与机器人观测可通行性。
result: 在Unitree Go2上的实验中，AVALON结合X-NavDP完成12.81 m的Intersection-to-Dining任务耗时46.4 s（成功率5/5），无需建图，机器人耗时比DimOS-Go2（78.5 s，4/5）减少40.9%；而仅使用策略的X-NavDP在5次运行中均超时。
conclusion: 结果表明AVALON拓扑导航框架在零样本、无建图室内导航中优于基线，并验证了人类先验记忆与机器人证据门控协同更新的有效性。其贡献在于降低部署对现场建图和训练的需求，提升服务机器人在人类熟悉、机器人未见环境中的任务适应性与导航效率。

title: CLAD: Keypoint Matching Using Global Line Correspondences
abstract: Traditional keypoint descriptors, such as SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) and ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF), are computed from local image patches. They may be unreliable in scenes with repetitive patterns or weak textures, where patches at different locations can look similar. We propose the Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor (CLAD), a keypoint matching method that addresses this problem by using global geometric context from line correspondences. CLAD represents each keypoint with a vector whose elements indicate its proximity to matched lines. It can therefore use the keypoint's spatial relationships to the lines in the scene. We use HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) to detect both clear and weak linear structures and to establish enough line-to-keypoint associations to represent this context. Evaluations on the TUM RGB-D SLAM dataset and outdoor video sequences show that CLAD provides geometrically consistent matches that complement those obtained with traditional local descriptors. In repetitive scenes, where local descriptors may not distinguish similar patches, CLAD uses global structure to improve matching reliability. The method is computationally lightweight and practical to implement.
tldr: CLAD利用全局线对应关系构建关键点描述子，以提升重复纹理场景下的匹配可靠性。
motivation: 传统SIFT、ORB等局部关键点描述子仅依赖局部图像块，在重复模式或弱纹理场景中不同位置图像块相似，导致匹配不可靠，因此需要引入全局几何上下文。
method: 提出CLAD，将每个关键点表示为到已匹配直线的邻近度向量，从而编码其与场景中直线的全局空间关系；并使用HOME在Hough空间检测强弱线性结构，建立足够的线-关键点关联以表示该上下文。
result: 在TUM RGB-D SLAM数据集和户外视频序列上评估，CLAD能提供几何一致的匹配，补充传统局部描述子，并在重复场景中借助全局结构提高匹配可靠性；方法计算轻量、易于实现。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: CLAD表明全局线对应可为关键点匹配提供有效几何上下文，改善局部描述子在重复或弱纹理场景中的不足，且计算开销低，具有实际应用潜力。

title: GeoPano: Towards Geometrically Accurate 3D Reconstruction from a Single Panorama
abstract: Panoramic 3D reconstruction enables the holistic recovery of complete 360 $^\circ$ scene geometry, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, directly estimating geometry from ERP images is inherently challenged by spherical distortions. To reduce spherical projection distortions, a common strategy is to decompose panoramas into distortion-free perspective views, but independently processing these views often introduces cross-view geometric inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoPano, a feed-forward framework for single-view panoramic 3D reconstruction that recovers a geometrically accurate and consistent point cloud from a single panorama. Our approach is driven by two key innovations: First, we propose a panoramic-aware attention aggregator, featuring a streamlined attention architecture equipped with a novel Pano-Attention mechanism, which explicitly exploits the intrinsic spherical geometry of the panorama to guide cross-view interactions, thereby suppressing geometric inconsistencies. Furthermore, we formulate a hybrid supervision strategy to jointly enforce fine-grained local details in perspective space and global structural coherence in spherical space. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches in reconstruction accuracy, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.
tldr: GeoPano 用全景感知注意力和混合监督，从单张全景图重建几何准确且一致的点云。
motivation: 单张全景图可整体恢复360°场景几何，对机器人和AR/VR很有价值，但ERP图像的球面畸变使直接估计几何困难；拆成无畸变透视视图分别处理又会引入跨视图几何不一致。
method: 提出GeoPano前馈框架，从单张全景图恢复几何准确且一致的点云。核心包括带Pano-Attention的全景感知注意力聚合器，利用全景内在球面几何引导跨视图交互以抑制不一致，并采用混合监督在透视空间约束局部细节、在球面空间约束全局结构一致性。
result: 实验表明GeoPano在重建精度、几何一致性和视觉保真度上显著优于此前SOTA方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GeoPano通过显式利用全景球面几何与混合监督，缓解了球面畸变和跨视图不一致问题，实现了单视图全景三维重建的几何准确与一致，对机器人和AR/VR应用具有潜在影响。

title: ResStreamGS: Residual-Sensitive Dual-Stream Gaussian Splatting for Mobile Volumetric Video Streaming
abstract: Real-time mobile volumetric video enables immersive free-viewpoint experiences, but delivering high-quality 3D content under constrained bandwidth and computation remains challenging. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) systems, such as V$^3$, enable efficient mobile streaming by encoding time-varying Gaussian attributes with commodity video codecs and hardware decoding. However, existing pipelines treat all Gaussians as frame-varying signals, which is poorly suited to full-scene content where large portions remain temporally stable. Our empirical study shows that frame-wise adaptation and video coding of all Gaussians cause quality degradation in complex full-scene content, particularly in temporally stable regions. To address this issue, we propose ResStreamGS, a residual-sensitive dual-stream framework that processes Gaussians according to their temporal behavior. ResStreamGS identifies residual-sensitive primitives through lightweight probe adaptation and reuses stable Gaussians within each Group of Pictures (GOP). Stable Gaussians are transmitted once per GOP, while only residual-sensitive Gaussians remain in the frame-wise hardware-decodable video stream. Experiments on complex full-scene volumetric videos show that ResStreamGS improves post-codec PSNR by 7.51--8.35~dB over a controlled V$^3$-style all-Gaussians baseline, reduces amortized payload by up to 56.5%, and achieves 30.883~FPS on a Qualcomm Snapdragon 778G platform.
tldr: ResStreamGS提出残差敏感双流框架，按高斯时序行为分流编码，提升移动体视频流质量并降低带宽。
motivation: 现有3DGS移动流媒体方案（如V³）将所有高斯视为逐帧变化信号，对包含大量时序稳定区域的全场景内容适配与视频编码效果差，导致稳定区域质量下降。
method: ResStreamGS通过轻量级探针自适应识别残差敏感图元，在GOP内复用稳定高斯（每GOP仅传输一次），仅将残差敏感高斯保留在逐帧硬件可解码视频流中，形成双流框架。
result: 在复杂全场景体视频上，后编码PSNR较受控V³式全高斯基线提升7.51–8.35 dB，摊销负载最多降低56.5%，并在高通骁龙778G平台达到30.883 FPS。
conclusion: 该工作表明按高斯时序行为分流可显著提升移动体视频流的质量与带宽效率，为实时自由视点移动流媒体提供了实用方案。

title: RoboCloth: A Large-Scale Real Cloth Material Dataset for Neural Reflectance Reconstruction
abstract: We present RoboCloth, a dataset of 500 real cloth materials captured under flexible, calibrated camera and lighting configurations, where both are robotically controlled during acquisition. Each material is imaged in approximately 580 high-dynamic range frames spanning a wide view-light hemisphere; camera poses are refined via structure-from-motion and aligned to the robot frame, yielding per-material sparse surface geometry and structured per-point reflectance observations ready for neural material training. We demonstrate the value of this data through a two-stage neural reconstruction pipeline: Stage 1 trains a shared MLP decoder on our corpus to learn cloth material priors; Stage 2 then freezes the decoder and fits a dense 2048x2048 latent texture to each target material. Evaluating on held-out materials from our own dataset and on the independent UBO2014 benchmark, we show that a decoder trained on our captures outperforms decoders trained on existing measured reflectance datasets and analytic PBR fitting, transferring to unseen acquisition systems without modification. The dataset, calibration files, observation tensors, and train/test splits are released under CC BY 4.0 on the Hugging Face Hub.
tldr: RoboCloth发布500种真实布料的大规模机器人采集数据集，并验证其可训练出可迁移的神经材质重建解码器。
motivation: 神经材质重建依赖大规模、标定准确的真实反射率数据，而现有实测数据集在布料材质覆盖度、视角-光照采样范围与机器人可复现采集方面均存在不足。
method: 通过机器人同时控制标定相机与光源，对每种布料采集约580张覆盖宽视角-光照半球的高动态范围图像，经SfM精化相机位姿并对齐机器人坐标系，得到每材质稀疏表面几何与结构化逐点反射观测；重建采用两阶段流程，Stage 1在本语料上训练共享MLP解码器学习布料材质先验，Stage 2冻结解码器并为每个目标材质拟合2048x2048密集潜纹理。
result: 数据集包含500种真实布料、每材质约580帧HDR观测；在本数据集留出材质与独立UBO2014基准上，本数据集训练的解码器均优于现有实测反射率数据集训练的解码器与解析PBR拟合，且无需修改即可迁移到未见过的采集系统。
conclusion: 该工作提供了大规模真实布料反射率数据集及配套标定文件、观测张量和训练/测试划分，并以CC BY 4.0在Hugging Face Hub公开，为神经材质重建提供可复现的数据基础与可迁移先验。

title: RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching
abstract: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app
tldr: RoPE-Flow 基于 2D 图条件 3D 流匹配，从单目图像端到端估计机器人位姿。
motivation: 单目图像相机到机器人位姿估计对视觉导航与控制重要，但从 2D 观测恢复 3D 结构仍困难；现有方法依赖耗时迭代渲染或复杂 2D-3D 配准，存在投影歧义、远端关节误差累积和关节学习不均衡问题。
method: 提出端到端流匹配框架 RoPE-Flow：基于预测 2D 热图，用 Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor 提取关键点中心多尺度块的位置与上下文特征；用 Graph-guided Condition Generator 嵌入可学习邻接图，按关键点相关性生成流匹配条件；并引入 Bone Length Loss 与 Ray-Depth Loss 及关节加权，保障拓扑一致性与尺度稳定性。
result: 在多种机器人与多相机配置下，RoPE-Flow 的位姿估计性能优于现有 SOTA；还建立新的跨场景基准，展示其在零样本跨场景机器人位姿估计上的突出表现，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: RoPE-Flow 以 2D 图条件 3D 流匹配实现端到端单目机器人位姿估计，缓解投影歧义与关节不平衡，并推动零样本跨场景泛化；可视化见 ropeflow.netlify.app。

title: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only. We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for {\pi}3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.
tldr: 提出基于LUPI的运动与重力先验前馈三维重建框架，在不增加推理复杂度下提升动态场景鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有前馈Transformer多视图三维重建主要依赖外观注意力，在动态场景和弱几何线索下仍易失败。本文旨在将运动与物理先验注入几何表征学习，同时保持推理阶段的标准视觉输入和前馈效率。
method: 在Learning Using Privileged Information范式下，训练时引入残差光流和重力方向作为特权信号指导几何表征学习，推理时仅使用标准视觉输入。通过轻量级架构改动将这些先验集成到Transformer骨干中，并分析不同骨干的最优注入阶段。
result: 在标准基准上取得一致的 reconstruction accuracy 与鲁棒性提升，尤其在动态物体、结构歧义和困难相机运动场景中表现更好；摘要未给出具体量化指标。分析表明最优注入阶段依赖骨干：VGGT通常适合中层注入，而π3更适合后期注入。
conclusion: 结果表明LUPI为前馈三维重建注入运动与物理先验提供了实用途径，且不增加测试时复杂度。注入阶段应随骨干架构调整，为后续架构感知的先验融合设计提供了依据。

title: Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation
abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.
tldr: Anchor3DGS提出基于紧凑锚点的无位姿前馈3DGS，以熵引导锚点分布并用更少高斯基元实现SOTA新视角合成。
motivation: 现有前馈3DGS多采用像素对齐范式，每个输入像素预测一个高斯，导致高斯基元数量与输入分辨率和视角数耦合，在无纹理区域产生冗余、在几何复杂区域覆盖不足。
method: 提出无位姿前馈3DGS框架Anchor3DGS，用紧凑的3D锚点表示替代像素对齐预测；基于信息熵在视觉复杂度高区域集中放置锚点并保持空间覆盖，每个锚点进行遮挡感知的多视角特征聚合、锚点间信息交换并解码为局部高斯，最后用轻量特征增强模块细化高斯泼溅的粗RGB输出。
result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，Anchor3DGS达到SOTA新视角合成质量，同时仅使用少一个数量级的高斯基元。
conclusion: 该方法将高斯基元数量与输入分辨率和视角数解耦，减少无纹理区域冗余并改善复杂几何覆盖，为高效前馈3DGS提供了紧凑锚点表示的新路线。

title: GeoPano: Towards Geometrically Accurate 3D Reconstruction from a Single Panorama
abstract: Panoramic 3D reconstruction enables the holistic recovery of complete 360 $^\circ$ scene geometry, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, directly estimating geometry from ERP images is inherently challenged by spherical distortions. To reduce spherical projection distortions, a common strategy is to decompose panoramas into distortion-free perspective views, but independently processing these views often introduces cross-view geometric inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoPano, a feed-forward framework for single-view panoramic 3D reconstruction that recovers a geometrically accurate and consistent point cloud from a single panorama. Our approach is driven by two key innovations: First, we propose a panoramic-aware attention aggregator, featuring a streamlined attention architecture equipped with a novel Pano-Attention mechanism, which explicitly exploits the intrinsic spherical geometry of the panorama to guide cross-view interactions, thereby suppressing geometric inconsistencies. Furthermore, we formulate a hybrid supervision strategy to jointly enforce fine-grained local details in perspective space and global structural coherence in spherical space. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches in reconstruction accuracy, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.
tldr: GeoPano 以全景感知注意力与混合监督，从单张全景图前馈重建几何一致的点云。
motivation: 全景图可直接恢复360°场景几何，但ERP图像的球面畸变使几何估计困难；拆分为透视视图虽减轻畸变，却易造成跨视图几何不一致。GeoPano旨在从单张全景图同时获得几何准确且一致的点云。
method: 提出前馈框架GeoPano，采用Pano-Attention的全景感知注意力聚合器，利用全景内在球面几何引导跨视图交互以抑制不一致；并设计混合监督策略，在透视空间约束局部细节、在球面空间约束全局结构连贯性。
result: 实验表明GeoPano在重建精度、几何一致性和视觉保真度上显著优于此前SOTA；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GeoPano为单张全景图的几何准确、一致三维重建提供了有效方案，有望促进机器人与AR/VR中的全景感知应用。

title: RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching
abstract: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: this http URL
tldr: 提出RoPE-Flow，用2D图条件3D流匹配实现单目机器人位姿估计。
motivation: 单目图像恢复机器人相机位姿对导航控制很重要，但从2D观测恢复3D结构仍困难；现有方法或依赖耗时迭代渲染，或采用复杂2D-3D配准，存在投影歧义、远端关节误差累积和关节学习不均衡问题。
method: RoPE-Flow是端到端流匹配框架：基于预测的2D热图，用Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor从关键点中心多尺度块提取位置与上下文特征；Graph-guided Condition Generator借助可学习邻接图按关键点相关性生成流匹配条件；并引入Bone Length Loss与Ray-Depth Loss及关节级加权，保证拓扑一致性和尺度稳定。
result: 在不同类型机器人和多相机设置下，RoPE-Flow优于现有最先进位姿估计方法；作者还建立新的跨场景基准，展示其在零样本跨场景机器人位姿估计上的突出性能。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法将图条件3D流匹配用于单目机器人位姿估计，缓解投影歧义与关节不均衡，并通过拓扑/尺度约束提升稳定性；跨场景零样本表现显示其泛化潜力。

title: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations.
